# Company
> no~bull consulting is a UK software company (trading name of Edward Jenkins,
> sole trader) that builds open-source, UK-hosted business applications for UK
> sole traders and micro-businesses. The company develops nSuite, a growing
> family of purpose-built SaaS tools. Products are built on open-source
> foundations, hosted on UK servers, with full data export always available —
> no proprietary lock-in.
> Website: https://nobull.consulting
> Contact: hello@nobull.consulting

## Products

### nBooks
- URL: https://nobull.consulting/products.html#books
- App: https://books.nobull.consulting
- Status: Live
- Category: Accounting software
- Target: UK sole traders, freelancers, micro-businesses (1-5 employees)
- Description: Cloud-based accounting software built for HMRC Making Tax Digital
  (MTD) compliance. Features include MTD for VAT direct submission, MTD for
  Income Tax Self Assessment (ITSA) quarterly updates, professional invoicing
  with PDF generation, bank reconciliation, multi-currency support, expense
  claims with AI receipt scanning, HMRC mileage rates, multi-user
  access with role-based permissions (Owner/Admin/Accountant/Staff/ReadOnly),
  Xero and QuickBooks migration facility, financial reports (P&L, Balance Sheet,
  Trial Balance, Aged Debtors, Cash Flow, SA103), and PayPal payment links on
  invoices. Data is stored on UK-based servers, built on open-source software.
  Full data export available at any time — no proprietary lock-in.
- Pricing: From £9/month (Starter), £15/month (Pro), £49/month (Accountant Plus).
  Annual plans available (save 2 months). 30-day free trial, no credit card required.
- HMRC: MTD application submitted June 2026, pending HMRC recognition.
- Tech: Open source, self-hosted, UK-based infrastructure

### nLearn (in development)
- Status: In development
- Category: Training management
- Description: Training management for small teams — course tracking,
  certifications, and compliance records, plugged into the same shared
  contacts as the rest of nSuite.

### nSales (planned)
- Status: Planned
- Category: CRM / pipeline management
- Description: Lead and pipeline management that integrates directly with
  nBooks. Convert won deals to invoices without double-entry.

### nWork (planned)
- Status: Planned
- Category: Project management / time tracking
- Description: Time-tracking and milestone management for consultants and
  freelancers, with real-time project profitability from connected accounts.

### nDocs (planned)
- Status: Planned
- Category: Document management
- Description: Document management for small businesses — store, share, and
  version the paperwork behind your books.

### nSpark (planned)
- Status: Planned
- Category: AI / LLM tools
- Description: AI and LLM tools woven through the rest of nSuite, extending
  the same intelligence already behind nBooks' receipt scanning.

## Pluggable Architecture
Each nSuite product works standalone, or plugs into the others as a
business grows. Products share common data (starting with contacts) so
customers and suppliers stay consistent across every tool used.

## Bespoke Development
- URL: https://nobull.consulting/services.html
- no~bull consulting also builds bespoke applications for
  businesses with specific workflow requirements. Fixed-price proposals,
  iterative delivery, client owns the code.

## Key Differentiators
- Open source: nBooks is built on open, auditable software — no proprietary black box
- UK-hosted: financial data is stored on UK-based servers, under UK data protection law
- No lock-in: full data export, anytime, at no charge, in open formats
- MTD-first: both VAT and ITSA submissions built in to all paid plans
- Xero migration: full chart of accounts, invoices, bills, contacts import
- Fair pricing: from £9/month vs Xero £16+/month

## MTD Mandate Timeline
- MTD for VAT: active now, all VAT-registered businesses
- MTD ITSA >£50,000: April 2026
- MTD ITSA >£30,000: April 2027
- MTD ITSA >£20,000: April 2028
